name: Striving Forward
source:
An ordinary young man with with grand dreams striving for success in a career that exceeds his qualifications.
However, with the start of the internship, a breath of fresh air begins.
A new encounter creates a beginning.
A long-time friendship now blossoming into something more.
A relationship flourishes in the pursuit of happiness.
A concealed truth that could evolve into a relationship filled with pain.
A surprising connection forms between two individuals with nothing in common, leading to a heart-wrenching romance.
A life once monotonous is now illuminated with vibrant colors by different girls.
